shared_elements: a large figure rendered in profile occupying the field
justification: A shows a single massive, amorphous creature-like body in high relief filling the whole field, with what may be a head and eye at one end and no accompanying signs; B shows a composed multi-figure scene in a lunette \u2014 a rayed disc above, standing human figures flanking an offering table, framed by dense registers of small script signs. Beyond the trivial fact that both contain a body seen from the side, there is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and completely different conventions (a solitary swelling volumetric mass versus flat, linear, text-integrated narrative figures).
